title: Decision-tree process distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite alphabet, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree on inputs in $\Omega^n$. The process distribution of $T$ is the distribution of the process sample obtained by drawing each of the $n$ input coordinates independently according to $\pi$ and recording the resulting input and its query trace.
